notes: Manually traced from the supplied technical ground-floor image. Coordinates are approximate to 1–3 px, not survey measurements.
Only thick, double-outline wall bands are represented. Furniture, cabinetry, stair treads, cars, landscape, dimensions and dashed porch outlines are excluded.
Visible breaks for doors and glazing are retained. No lintels, glazing, railings, doors, slabs, or missing wall heights are inferred.
The mandir curved corner uses a sampled quarter-ring following the visible curve, with approx 15 px wall thickness. It must be extruded as a polygon, not filled as a solid quarter-disc.
A short bold return beside the service shaft/toilet is included; thin shaft screens are excluded. Small jamb rebates below 5 px are simplified.
The outlined vestibule has thin glazing/open boundaries. These are not assumed to be full-height opaque walls.
The ground technical plan is a different raster scale from first and second. Match stair enclosure outer width, not source image dimensions; lift center is the registration anchor.
Wall heights are not provided on this drawing. Any displayed height must be explicitly labelled illustrative.
